concepts.title: Focal Length of Spherical Mirrors
concepts.definition: The focal length of a spherical mirror is defined as half of its radius of curvature, representing the distance from the pole to the principal focus.
concepts.key_idea: The principal focus lies exactly halfway between the mirror pole and the center of curvature.

solution_steps.explain: focal length is half the radius of curvature

concepts.title: Mirror Equation
concepts.definition: A mathematical relationship connecting the distances of an object and its image from the mirror pole to the mirror's focal length.
concepts.key_idea: The reciprocal of focal length equals the sum of reciprocals of image and object distances.

concepts.title: Power of a Lens
concepts.definition: The power of a lens quantifies its ability to converge or diverge light, defined as the reciprocal of its focal length in meters.
concepts.key_idea: Shorter focal length lenses have higher power, measured in dioptres.

concepts.title: Combination of Thin Lenses
concepts.definition: When multiple thin lenses are placed in contact, their combined power is the algebraic sum of the individual powers of each lens.
concepts.key_idea: Total power is the sum of individual lens powers.
